about: Kie.ai's image, video and speech models as media-generator offers them, read from each model's page of docs.kie.ai (its own capacities, never OpenRouter's). Kept by hand: add, remove or fix a model here. id: OpenRouter's id for the same model, so a tool's list holds for both routers; kie: the model sent to createTask, or one by mode (text, frames, refs, video, avatar); fields: the engine's names → Kie's input keys (« key[] » takes a list); values: rewrites before sending; price: rules read in order, rows of Kie's price API (api.kie.ai/client/v1/model-pricing/page), in: the input video's seconds billed too; cite: the names a model wants in its prompt. The models Kie lists and this lacks are added by providers/kie.js from its docs (read at each start of the dashboard's server and once a day).
